questions.q: If HELLO = 52 and MATH = 42, then what is the value of MOM?
questions.s:
Pattern: Sum of positional values of letters (A=1, B=2, ... Z=26)

HELLO: H=8, E=5, L=12, L=12, O=15 → 8+5+12+12+15 = 52 ✓

MATH: M=13, A=1, T=20, H=8 → 13+1+20+8 = 42 ✓

MOM: M=13, O=15, M=13 → 13+15+13 = 41

Answer: Option 3 (41)

questions.q: In a certain code language, “AN” is coded as “16”, and “NO” is coded as “212”. How will “US” be coded in that language?
questions.s:
The pattern followed here is:

Coded word = (Positional value of 1st letter) × (Positional value of 2nd letter) + 2

  • In AN → 16 
    • Positional value of A and N = 1 and 14
    • Hence, coded word = (1 × 14) + 2 = 14 + 2 = 16
  • In NO → 212 
    • Positional value of N and O = 14 and 15
    • Hence, coded word = (14 × 15) + 2 = 210 + 2 = 212
  • Similarly, US → ? 
    • Positional value of U and S = 21 and 19
    • Hence, coded word = (21 × 19) + 2 = 399 + 2 = 401

Hence, Option 3) is the correct answer.

questions.s:
11.(b) Logic :- (Sum of the place value of letters) ÷ 5

ABOVE :- (1 + 2 + 15 + 22 + 5) ÷ 5 ⇒ (45) ÷ 5 = 9

SHINE :- (19 + 8 + 9 + 14 + 5) ÷ 5 ⇒ (55) ÷ 5 =11

Similarly,

PARTY :- (16 + 1 + 18 +20 + 25) ÷ 5 ⇒ (80) ÷ 5 = 16
